description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended mirvetuximab soravtansine, within its marketing authorisation, as an option to treat FR-alpha-positive, platinum-resistant, high-grade serous epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer in adults after 1 to 3 lines of systemic treatment. Mirvetuximab soravtansine is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
